name: gaps2-construction-two-docks
description: User report (deliberate improvement over the original): Construction let a player place two space docks. Rules text (Prophecy of Kings Construction) primary: 'Place 1 PDS or 1 space dock on a planet you control. Place 1 PDS on a planet you control.'; secondary: 'Spend 1 token from your strategy pool ... you may place either 1 space dock or 1 PDS on a planet you control in that system.' Naalu (holder, pbd105) places a space dock on Qucenn; a second space dock (construction_spacedock) must be refused ('Construction's second structure must be a PDS'); a PDS on Maaluuk is accepted; a third structure is refused. Ral Nel (follower) places 1 PDS on Mez; a second structure is refused. Bot: ButtonHelperSCs.construction / ButtonHelperModifyUnits.genericPlaceUnit + ScFollowGate press hook (ConstructionLimits); engine: strategy_card.resolve / construction_place validate.
